eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 IEEE Conference on Secure and Trustworthy Machine Learning (SaTML)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.scope: The conference brings together researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to discuss the security and trustworthiness of machine learning. Conference topics include: - Novel attacks and defenses for machine learning - Security and privacy in learning-based systems - Forensic analysis and interpretability - Trusted data curation and management - Verification and certification of learning models - Privacy and fairness in machine learning
